name: 10c-convert-text-completion-degenerate
description: The empty-array degenerate case of convertTextCompletionPrompt (prompt-converters.js:961-977). An empty array is NOT an empty string: the join produces '', and the tail at :976 is appended unconditionally, so the result is exactly '\nassistant:'. A port that early-returns '' for an empty prompt -- a very natural Python instinct -- diverges here. The string passthrough at :962-964 is the companion fixture 10d, because the runner calls one fixture once and the function takes one argument.
